caption: The drawing consists of four distinct metallic objects, each rendered using greenish-yellow and brownish tones on a neutral cream background, and numbered 1 through 4 in red on the left side. The first object at the top is an elongated, symmetrical, double-pointed piece with a slight curve and notched ends, as well as small circular cutouts near each pointed tip. The second object features a curved, ornate shape resembling a bracket or handle with a hook at one end and two looping extensions in the middle, highlighted with fine brown lines to indicate contour and dimension. The third object is a circular, flat plate with three small protruding attachment holes and a single pointed extension to the right, all shaded to indicate a metallic, slightly worn surface. The fourth object at the bottom is a sharply angled bracket with a long, straight arm extending from a curled, hook-like base, the shading emphasizing its three-dimensionality. In the bottom right corner, the name "Chas. F. Moss" and the year "32" are written in red.
title: Patch Pocket and Decorations on Ky. Rifle
